name: local-vscode-extensions
description: Build orchestration for four independently packaged VS Code extensions.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix Automato install --yes && npm --prefix context-copy-search install --yes && npm --prefix hot-tabs install --yes && npm --prefix pickaxe install --yes
scripts.build:all: npm run build:automato && npm run build:context-copy-search && npm run build:hot-tabs && npm run build:pickaxe
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix Automato test && npm --prefix context-copy-search test && npm run build:hot-tabs && npm run build:pickaxe
scripts.package:all: npm run package:automato && npm run package:context-copy-search && npm run package:hot-tabs && npm run package:pickaxe
